analysis.summary: Living room shows one split AC, one ceiling fan, multiple recessed downlights, one decorative chandelier, and one window wall with curtains. Biggest savings come from upgrading downlights/chandelier to efficient LEDs, ensuring AC is inverter-rated and well-sealed around the window/curtain perimeter, and using fan-first cooling in Jaipur’s mild 20.62°C conditions.

opportunities.title: Split AC (wall-mounted) – likely non-inverter/older efficiency
opportunities.description: One wall-mounted split AC detected. Older/non-inverter units commonly draw higher average power and short-cycle, especially with leaky window/curtain edges.
opportunities.fix_action: Upgrade to 5-star inverter split AC (properly sized) and ensure installation sealing; use 24–26°C setpoint with fan assist.

opportunities.title: Ceiling Fan – standard AC induction type
opportunities.description: One ceiling fan detected. Conventional fans are typically 70–80W at high speed.
opportunities.fix_action: Replace with BLDC fan (or use BLDC regulator) to cut fan energy ~50–65%.

opportunities.title: Decorative chandelier/ring light fixture – higher watt decorative LEDs
opportunities.description: One multi-arm decorative ceiling fixture detected; decorative fixtures often use higher total wattage than needed for ambient lighting.
opportunities.fix_action: Use a high-efficacy dimmable LED fixture or reduce driver power; add scene control (dim/only task lighting).

opportunities.title: Recessed ceiling downlight #1 (left)
opportunities.description: One recessed round downlight detected; older halogen or low-efficacy LED can be 12–15W.
opportunities.fix_action: Replace with 7–9W high-efficacy LED downlight (>=100 lm/W).

opportunities.title: Window/glazing – heat gain/loss through glass
opportunities.description: Large window section behind curtains can be a major thermal path (solar gain in summer, heat loss in winter nights).
opportunities.fix_action: Use low-E film/double glazing where feasible; keep curtains closed during peak sun; add exterior shading if possible.

opportunities.title: Curtains/drapes – possible air leakage at edges/top
opportunities.description: Curtains detected; gaps around curtain edges/top often allow warm air infiltration and AC loss.
opportunities.fix_action: Add curtain pelmet/valance, ensure full coverage to floor, seal window frame gaps; consider thermal/blackout lining.

opportunities.title: Thermal leak source – window frame/perimeter infiltration zone
opportunities.description: Likely leakage at window perimeter (frame-to-wall, sliding tracks) contributing to AC load.
opportunities.fix_action: Weatherstrip/window track seal, silicone caulk at frame joints; ensure tight latch/closing.

analysis.summary: Living room shows one split AC, two lamps, and one window. Biggest savings come from upgrading AC to inverter/high-SEER and swapping lamp bulbs to LEDs. Window is a likely thermal leak source; add sealing and reflective/insulating window treatment to reduce AC load in Jaipur conditions.

opportunities.title: Wall-Mounted Split AC (Non-inverter/older efficiency assumed)
opportunities.description: Split AC detected; older fixed-speed units commonly draw higher power and cycle frequently, increasing consumption and discomfort.
opportunities.fix_action: Upgrade to 5-star inverter split AC (right-sized; clean filters; set 24–26°C; use sleep/eco mode).

opportunities.title: Floor Lamp (Likely incandescent/CFL bulb)
opportunities.description: Standing floor lamp detected; older bulbs waste energy as heat.

opportunities.title: Table Lamp (Likely incandescent/CFL bulb)
opportunities.description: Table lamp on side table detected; older bulbs are inefficient and add heat load.

opportunities.title: Window - Single glazing/air leakage risk
opportunities.description: Window detected; likely conductive and infiltration losses/gains around frame. In Jaipur, reducing solar gain and sealing leaks lowers cooling energy.
opportunities.fix_action: Add weatherstripping/caulk, install reflective film or double-layer curtains; consider double glazing for long-term upgrade.

opportunities.title: Window Frame/Perimeter Thermal Leak
opportunities.description: Likely air leakage at window perimeter (common infiltration point). This increases AC runtime and dust ingress (haze conditions).
opportunities.fix_action: Seal gaps with silicone/PU sealant; add compression weatherstrips; ensure tight latch alignment.
